realms.name: The Harbour
realms.blurb: Your boat has just arrived. Everyone at the harbour is friendly, and all you need are your first words.
realms.goal: Say hello, say who you are, and name the things around you.
can_do: I can greet someone and say goodbye.
I can say my name, where I am from and what I do.
I can count, and say prices and times.
I can name everyday things and people around me.
I can ask someone to repeat or speak more slowly.
landmarks: I am / you are / it is

exit.title: Meet the Guide
exit.description: A short, friendly chat with the Guide: say hello, introduce yourself and answer a few simple questions. Then a recall check on the harbour's words.

realms.name: Market Town
realms.blurb: The road from the harbour leads to a busy market. To get what you need, you have to ask.
realms.goal: Ask for and give simple information about everyday life.
can_do: I can talk about my daily routine.
I can ask for things in a shop and understand the price.
I can say what I like and what I can do.
I can ask and answer simple questions about people, places and things.
I can describe where things are.

exit.title: A day at the market
exit.description: Buy what you need from the Shopkeeper: ask, check prices, and sort out one small problem. Then a recall check on the market's words and phrases.

realms.name: The Crossroads
realms.blurb: Paths lead in every direction. Here you learn to tell people where you have been and where you are going.
realms.goal: Describe your past, your routines and your plans, and ask direct questions.
can_do: I can say what I did yesterday, last week or last year.
I can describe my plans for the weekend or next year.
I can ask questions with who, what, where, when, why and how.
I can compare two things, places or people.
I can write a short message or note about everyday things.

exit.title: Getting to know the Neighbour
exit.description: Talk with the Neighbour about your life, your past and your plans, and ask questions back. Write a short message inviting them somewhere.

realms.name: The Bridge
realms.blurb: The bridge joins everyday talk to the working world. Crossing it means telling stories and giving reasons.
realms.goal: Tell a story, give opinions with reasons, and handle most work and travel conversations.
can_do: I can tell a story or describe an experience in order.
I can give my opinion and a reason for it.
I can ask polite, indirect questions.
I can explain a problem and ask for help at work.
I can write a clear email about a familiar topic.

exit.title: A problem at work
exit.description: Explain a problem to the Colleague, give your view with reasons, and agree the next step. Write an email that sums it up.

realms.name: The City
realms.blurb: The city is loud with opinions. To be heard, you need to argue clearly and listen well.
realms.goal: Argue a point of view, weigh advantages and disadvantages, and take part in meetings.
can_do: I can argue for a view and answer objections.
I can compare the advantages and disadvantages of options.
I can report what other people said.
I can take part in a meeting: interrupt politely, agree, disagree.
I can write a clear, organised argument.

exit.title: The great debate
exit.description: Debate a question with the Debater: state your view, give evidence, handle the other side politely. Write a short argument.

realms.name: The Summit
realms.blurb: The air is thin at the summit. Every word counts, and precision is what gets you heard.
realms.goal: Speak and write precisely for work and study, with clear structure and the right tone.
can_do: I can express how sure I am, from certain to doubtful.
I can structure a talk or report so it is easy to follow.
I can change my tone for formal and informal situations.
I can answer hard questions with evidence.
I can summarise a complex text accurately.

exit.title: The interview
exit.description: A hard interview for a job you want: tell your story with evidence and handle difficult questions. Write a structured report.

realms.name: The Grand Hall
realms.blurb: The Grand Hall is where people come to be persuaded. Here you speak to a room.
realms.goal: Persuade, explain between people, and adapt your language to any audience.
can_do: I can persuade an audience with a clear message and good evidence.
I can explain a complex idea simply for people who are new to it.
I can help two people with different views understand each other.
I can use idiom, irony and nuance when they help, and avoid them when they don't.
I can write persuasively for a specific reader.

exit.title: Speak to the hall
exit.description: Give a short talk to the Audience and take their questions. Write a persuasive piece for a named reader.
